newsitem.title: USA: Halter Marine says to buy rest of TDI shares.
newsitem.headline: Halter Marine says to buy rest of TDI shares.

text.p: Halter Marine Group Inc said on Tuesday that after acquiring 51 percent of the common stock of privately owned Texas Drydock Inc on April 4, it had agreed to acquire the remaining common stock of that company, re-named TDI-Halter Inc.
TDI-Halter now operates six shipyards in southeast Texas and a joint venture shipyard in Bahrain, Halter Marine said in a statement.
According to the announcement, made at a conference in Houston, closing is expected in seven to 10 days. Terms of the agreement were not disclosed.

On April 23, TDI-Halter said it had signed a contract worth about $80 million with Perforadora Central S.A. de C.V. of Mexico City for the construction of a Le Tourneau Super 116 mobile offshore drilling unit. Halter Marine said a combination of its own and TDI-Halter facilities will build components for the rig and that the rig's hull will be constructed at Halter Marine's Pascagoula, Miss., shipyard.
Halter Marine, based in Gulfport, Miss., specializes in the design, construction, conversion and repair of mobile offshore drilling units and other vessels.
